## Biography

A bookmark in space. A white star, a formation of ships, a momentary constellation assembled from hulls and nav locks.

The DW3 flotilla gathered at Rendezvous Point to search for the missing Guinevere. Captain Yuen ordered wide cone sweeps, wake nets at twenty-kilometre intervals. For hours, nothing. Then CMDR Nor found the beacon — damaged, ancient, broadcasting a dead man's coordinates. Lya back-traced its trajectory to Praei2. The search pivoted from rescue to investigation.

Rendezvous Point has no permanent structures. No history. It is simply a place where explorers agreed to meet, drawn together by the mathematics of fuel efficiency and the human need to not search alone. Such places are the architecture of deep-space expeditions: invisible on maps, essential to survival.
